title: Reflex | Retry and recovery operations
description: Client outcomes, replica health, bounded retries and rebuild activity. Select a single simulation_run. SDK panels have application scope.

definition.content:
## Retry and recovery operations
Select **one simulation run** and the corresponding time range. Run `*` combines tagged runs; use a specific run for gauges and replica states.
Client results count each original request once, including retries and admission rejections. Server results count individual attempts that reached a replica. A crash or partition can therefore produce client failures without server attempts.
HTTP durations use simulation time; counter rates use wall time (aligned at 1× playback). Missing telemetry is not treated as healthy. Success rates include rejected requests; latency panels include successful requests only.

queries.query: sum:http.client.requests{$env AND $policy AND $run AND upstream:replica_pool AND $application}.as_count()

definition.content: These panels ignore run and policy filters. Reflex metrics select the retry_recovery controller/machine. TypeSafe metrics include all workloads in the application. State-machine transitions include ticks and control events; they are not counts of recovery interventions. Tokens are usage, not dollar cost.

queries.name: q1
queries.query: sum:reflex.evaluations{$env AND $application AND controller:retry_recovery} by {status}.as_count()

queries.name: q1
queries.query: sum:reflex.transitions{$env AND $application AND machine:retry_recovery} by {status}.as_count()

queries.name: q1
queries.query: p95:typesafe.client.call.duration{$env AND $application} by {model}

definition.title: TypeSafe tokens per bucket — all workloads

queries.name: q1
queries.query: sum:typesafe.client.tokens{$env AND $application} by {direction}.as_count()
